description: Curated, versioned list of AI-slop clichés injected into every Dossier and generation prompt as things to AVOID. Merged with each InspirationCard's own `avoid` list. Full enforcement (lorem lint, distinctiveness pass) lands in Phase 5.
forbidden: purple-to-blue diagonal gradients on a dark background
generic 'Get Started' / 'Sign up free' hero with floating 3D blobs
Lorem ipsum or any placeholder filler text
emoji used as UI icons instead of real icons
default shadcn zinc/slate look with no brand overrides
identical border-radius on every single element
glossy AI-generated 3D mascot or blob illustrations
meaningless 'Empower your workflow' / 'Unlock your potential' taglines
three identical feature cards with a generic icon, title and one sentence
stock-photo smiling team around a laptop
centered hero + subheading + two buttons with nothing distinctive
fake logos strip labeled 'Trusted by' with grey rectangles
over-rounded pill buttons everywhere with no hierarchy
generic dashboard with three stat cards and one line chart and no point of view
'Lorem'-style repeated cities/names (John Doe, Acme Inc, example@email.com) with no context
neon glow on a dark hero as the only art direction
